newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police report arrest of "Death Doctor".
newsitem.headline: Colombian police report arrest of "Death Doctor".

text.p: Colombian police reported the arrest on Tuesday of a bogus surgeon known by his alias as "the Doctor of Death."

A statement from the Judicial Police said Alexander Velez Bohorquez, who was arrested in the capital late on Monday, was wanted on at least one count of murder for botching an abortion that claimed the life of an 18-year-old earlier this year.
Velez, dubbed "the Doctor of Death", worked out of several clinics in the Bogota area, the statement said.
It did not elaborate, but the crime pages of Bogota dailies often carry reports about unlicensed doctors and dentists caught in the act of performing life-threatening surgery.
